# mood

> Investigations in financial sentiment analysis


## Pages in this subsection

- [mood](mood.html.md): Sentiment analysis for stock market data.
- [mood.dataset_makers](mood.dataset_makers.html.md): Tools to make datasets for training and testing models (for semantic attribute etc.)
- [mood.learn_sentiments](mood.learn_sentiments.html.md): Learning sentiments from data.
- [mood.model_analysis](mood.model_analysis.html.md): Tools for model analysis
- [mood.mood_modeling](mood.mood_modeling.html.md): Mood Modeling Module
- [mood.scripts](mood.scripts.html.md): Scripts for mood.
- [mood.scripts.financial_news_searches](mood.scripts.financial_news_searches.html.md): A script that searches for news and saves the results to a file.
- [mood.sentiment](mood.sentiment.html.md): Sentiment analysis tools
- [mood.tools](mood.tools.html.md): Tools for sentiment analysis
- [mood.util](mood.util.html.md): Utils for mood
